body_rubric.NO: Clearly missing or destroyed principal body/support, severe disorganization or fragmentation that prevents recognizing a plausible chair.
body_rubric.UNKNOWN: Views insufficient or genuinely ambiguous; never relabel as YES.
body_rubric.YES: Recognizable chair with coherent seat/back/support organization; no obvious missing main body or destroyed support. Quality defects recorded separately.

body_unknown_policy: At least 56/64 determinate body labels for DET and candidate required; otherwise gate NA. Count DET YES -> candidate UNKNOWN as lost YES and potential damage. New damage upper bound = DET YES -> candidate NO or UNKNOWN, must be <=2.
calibration_selection: Smallest sigma passing all frozen registration gates and this missing-value contract
noises: No redraw under any reward or visual result
review: Actual AI_PROXY visual reading, model names and scores concealed; every POST, matched scales/views; RAW visible only for context
